status: registered before new held-out results; module protocols bind exact fixtures and candidates
objectives: independent continuous-process reference, complete successors and gradients
deployed-policy action values and paired actual successors
causal raw-content frozen/joint comparison with strong baselines
complete process costs and explicit unavailable energy
primary_comparison: analytic dynamics minus ordinary dynamics under the same task-value controller (D-B)
evidence_rules: Preserve every frozen predecessor and negative result; do not overwrite prior evidence.
Module protocols, source hashes and candidate hashes precede held-out evaluation.
Select hyperparameters/checkpoints/controllers only on training/development data.
All input information, observed prefixes, external tariffs and legal actions are shared.
Qpi labels and actual executor use the same frozen continuation policy.
Different analytic models in separate tracks are named and never borrow qualification.
Engineering check success is separate from a positive scientific finding.
No observed test-driven repair may reuse its exposed test namespace as a fresh confirmation.

content_plan.scope: small CPU causal raw-input models, not natural media or foundation-model validation

cost_contract.primary: fresh-process CPU seconds including startup, data/model loading and output writes
cost_contract.no_double_count: nested worker CPU receipts are components of outer process totals; do not add both

analysis.independent_unit: fit seed; episodes or graph states are not independent fits
analysis.benefit: report paired effect and uncertainty; do not claim architecture advantage from a positive point estimate alone
analysis.quality_cost: jointly report paired quality and CPU; quality noninferiority margin 0.02 absolute task accuracy is diagnostic, no post-hoc relaxation
analysis.energy: null when unavailable, never estimated from CPU seconds times invented power

release: additive draft research PR; no production activation
